:::{#exm-closed-form-solution}
#### Least squares versus logistic regression

Minimizing the squared-error cost of a linear model over $\vcoef$
gives the normal equations $\stprod{\design} \vcoef = \tp{\design} \vy$.
When $\stprod{\design}$ is invertible,
the unique minimizer is the closed-form expression

$$
\hvcoef = \inv{\stprod{\design}} \tp{\design} \vy,
$$

so least squares has a closed-form solution.

The minimizer of the logistic regression cost,
$\hvcoef = \argmin_{\vcoef} C(\vcoef)$,
is a well-defined vector,
but no closed-form expression for it is known.
An iterative [algorithm](#def-algorithm) approximates it.

:::
